svg.title: Loom: a neural computer as a looped transformer
svg.desc: A bubble sort compiled to the 21-opcode Loom ISA, the real 155 by 1024 state tensor at one step, the eight fixed-weight layers that execute one instruction per forward pass, and the instruction executed at each of the 486 forward passes.
svg.text: every entry is −1, 0 or +1; columns 0–159 shown
attention matches PC to position codes
LOAD and FIND attention, snap to ±1
one-layer borrow chain, 6 thresholds per bit
L8 returns the state; each pass runs one instruction.
Column executed at each forward pass
Bubble sort of 34, 12, 45, 7, 23, 18: 486 forward passes, result 7, 12, 18, 23, 34, 45
no drift over millions of steps
Runs in the browser with ONNX Runtime and WebGPU
Verified on a Xilinx Alveo U200 FPGA
